title: 一般过去时（规则动词）
explanation: 一般过去时用于描述过去发生的动作。规则动词的过去式在词尾加 -ed，但有不同的拼写规则。否定用 didn't + 动词原形，疑问句用 Did + 主语 + 动词原形。
rules: 一般加 -ed：walk → walked, play → played
以 e 结尾只加 -d：live → lived, hope → hoped
辅音字母 + y 结尾变 y 为 i 加 -ed：study → studied
重读闭音节双写末字母加 -ed：stop → stopped

examples.en: I walked to school yesterday.
She studied English last night.
We cleaned the house on Sunday.

exercises.question: They ___ (visit) their grandparents last weekend.
找出错误并选择正确说法：I didn't went to school yesterday.
exercises.answer: I didn't go to school yesterday.
options: I didn't went to school yesterday.
I didn't go to school yesterday.
I no went to school yesterday.

exercises.question: 把单词排序成正确的句子（一般过去时：1. She 2. walked 3. to the park 4. yesterday）。
exercises.answer: she walked to the park yesterday

title: 一般过去时（不规则动词）
explanation: 不规则动词的过去式没有统一规律，需要逐个记忆。常见的不规则动词有 go-went, see-saw, eat-ate, take-took 等。否定和疑问形式与规则动词相同。
rules: 不规则动词过去式需单独记忆：go → went, see → saw, eat → ate
否定：didn't + 动词原形，如 didn't go
疑问：Did + 主语 + 动词原形，如 Did you go?
过去式变化类型多样：元音变化、辅音变化、词形完全不同等

examples.en: She went to Beijing last week.
I saw a movie yesterday.
We ate lunch at noon.

exercises.question: She ___ (go) to the store yesterday.
___ you see the movie last night?
找出错误并选择正确说法：I eated breakfast this morning.

title: 现在完成时（入门）
explanation: 现在完成时用于描述过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响，或从过去持续到现在的状态。结构为 have/has + 过去分词。常与 already, yet, just, ever, never 等副词连用。
rules: have / has + 过去分词
I / You / We / They + have + p.p.
He / She / It + has + p.p.
already（肯定句中）、yet（否定/疑问句中）、just 表示时间
ever / never 表示经历

examples.en: I have already finished my homework.
Have you ever been to Shanghai?
She has just arrived.

exercises.question: She ___ (finish) her report already.
I ___ never been to the UK.
找出错误并选择正确说法：I have ever visited Beijing last year.
options: I have visited Beijing last year.
I have visit Beijing last year.

title: 形容词比较级
explanation: 比较级用于两者之间的比较。短形容词加 -er，长形容词前加 more。基本结构为 比较级 + than。还有一些不规则变化需特别记忆。
rules: 短形容词加 -er：tall → taller, fast → faster
以 e 结尾只加 -r：large → larger
辅音 + y 结尾变 y 为 i 加 -er：happy → happier
长形容词前加 more：more beautiful, more expensive
不规则：good → better, bad → worse, far → farther/further

examples.en: This book is more interesting than that one.
She is taller than her sister.
Today is hotter than yesterday.

exercises.question: Summer is ___ (hot) than spring.
This movie is ___ (good) than the last one.
找出错误并选择正确说法：My brother is more tall than me.
exercises.answer: My brother is taller than me.
options: My brother is more tall than me.
My brother is taller than me.
My brother is most tall than me.

title: 形容词最高级
explanation: 最高级用于三者或以上的比较，表示最什么的。短形容词加 -est，长形容词前加 most。最高级前通常加 the。
rules: 短形容词加 -est：tall → the tallest
长形容词前加 the most：the most beautiful
不规则：good → the best, bad → the worst
常与 in + 范围或 of + 群体连用

examples.en: She is the best student in our class.
examples.zh: 她是我们班最好的学生。

examples.en: This is the most expensive restaurant in town.
Mt. Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
examples.zh: 珠穆朗玛峰是世界上最高的山。

exercises.question: This is the ___ (expensive) restaurant in town.
He is the ___ (tall) boy in the class.
找出错误并选择正确说法：This is the most cheap phone in the store.
exercises.answer: This is the cheapest phone in the store.
options: This is the most cheap phone in the store.
This is the cheapest phone in the store.
This is cheapest phone in the store.

title: 频率副词
explanation: 频率副词用于表示动作发生的频率。按频率从高到低排列：always (100%) → usually (80%) → often (60%) → sometimes (40%) → seldom (20%) → never (0%)。频率副词通常放在 be 动词之后、行为动词之前。
rules: be 动词之后：She is always late.
行为动词之前：I usually get up at 7.
助动词/情态动词之后：He can never remember.
sometimes 还可放在句首或句末

examples.en: I always brush my teeth before bed.
She is sometimes late for school.
He never eats fast food.

exercises.question: She ___ (always) arrives on time.
I ___ (usually / never) drink coffee in the morning.
找出错误并选择正确说法：He always is happy.

title: 情态动词 should 和 must
explanation: should 表示建议或应该做的事，must 表示义务或必须做的事。should 语气较温和，must 语气较强。否定形式：shouldn't（不应该）、mustn't（禁止）。
rules: should + 动词原形：表示建议或义务
must + 动词原形：表示必须或强烈义务
shouldn't 表示不应该
mustn't 表示禁止（不可以）
must 的否定回答用 needn't 或 don't have to

examples.en: You should drink more water.
You must wear a seatbelt in the car.
examples.zh: 在车里你必须系安全带。

examples.en: You shouldn't stay up too late.

exercises.question: You ___ (should / must) see a doctor if you feel sick.
You ___ (mustn't / shouldn't) touch the wet paint.
把单词排序成正确的句子（should：1. more 2. You 3. exercise 4. should）。

title: 时间介词
explanation: 英语中常用的时间介词有 at、on、in。at 用于具体时刻，on 用于具体日期和星期，in 用于较长的时间段如月份、年份、季节等。
rules: at 用于具体时刻：at 7 o'clock, at noon, at night
on 用于日期和星期：on Monday, on May 1st, on Christmas Day
in 用于时间段：in the morning, in 2024, in summer
for 表示持续时间，since 表示从某时间点起

examples.en: I wake up at 6:30 every day.
We have a meeting on Friday.
She was born in 1995.

exercises.question: I usually get up ___ 7 o'clock.
The concert is ___ Saturday.
找出错误并选择正确说法：I was born in May 1st, 1995.

title: 连词 and / but / or
explanation: 连词用于连接单词、短语或句子。and 表示并列或递进，but 表示转折或对比，or 表示选择或否定条件（否则）。
rules: and 连接并列成分：A and B
but 连接转折关系：A, but B
or 连接选择关系：A or B
否定句中用 or 代替 and：I don't like tea or coffee

examples.en: I like tea and coffee.
He is smart but lazy.
Would you like tea or coffee?

exercises.question: She is tired ___ happy.
Do you want rice ___ noodles?
把单词排序成正确的句子（and：1. I 2. like 3. and 4. cats 5. dogs）。

title: be going to 将来时
explanation: be going to 用于表示已有的计划或意图，以及根据当前迹象做出的预测。结构为 be (am/is/are) going to + 动词原形。
rules: be going to + 动词原形：表示计划或打算
根据迹象预测：Look at the clouds. It is going to rain.
am going to（I）、is going to（he/she/it）、are going to（you/we/they）
否定：be + not + going to + 动词原形

examples.en: I am going to study abroad next year.
Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.
We are going to have a party this weekend.
examples.zh: 我们这周末要举办派对。

exercises.question: Look at the clouds! It ___ (rain) soon.
We ___ (go) to the beach tomorrow.
找出错误并选择正确说法：She going to travel next month.
exercises.answer: She is going to travel next month.
options: She going to travel next month.
She is going to travel next month.
She is go to travel next month.

title: 一般将来时
explanation: 一般将来时表示将要发生的动作，常用 will / be going to 表达。
rules: will + 动词原形
be going to + 动词原形
时间词：tomorrow, next week

examples.en: I will visit you tomorrow.
She is going to buy a new car.

exercises.question: It ___ tomorrow.
找出错误：They will goes to the park.
exercises.answer: They will go to the park
options: They will go to the park
They will goes to the park
They will going to the park

title: 比较级和最高级
explanation: 比较级比较两者，最高级比较三者及以上。规则形容词加 er/est，多音节用 more/most。
rules: 两者：形容词比较级（+er 或 more）than
三者及以上：the 最高级（+est 或 most）
不规则：good-better-best

examples.en: This box is heavier than that one.
She is the best student in our class.
examples.zh: 她是我们班最好的学生。

exercises.question: My sister is ___ than me.
找出错误：He is more taller than his brother.
exercises.answer: He is taller than his brother
options: He is taller than his brother
He is more taller than his brother
He is tall than his brother

title: 宾格代词
explanation: 宾格代词在句子中作宾语，位于动词或介词之后。
rules: I → me, he → him, she → her, they → them
位于动词之后：help me
位于介词之后：for him

examples.en: Please give it to me.
John helped them yesterday.

exercises.question: Can you call ___ tonight?
找出错误：Tom and me went to the park.
exercises.answer: Tom and I went to the park
options: Tom and I went to the park
Tom and me went to the park
Tom and I go to the park

title: This / That / These / Those
explanation: 近处用 this/these，远处用 that/those。this/that 后接单数名词，these/those 后接复数。
rules: this / that + 单数
these / those + 复数
疑问句把 this/that 提前

examples.en: This is my sister.
Those are my classmates.

exercises.question: ___ is my pen.
找出错误：These book are new.

title: 祈使句
explanation: 祈使句表示请求、命令或建议，通常省略主语 you，动词用原形。
rules: 肯定：动词原形开头
否定：Don’t + 动词原形
委婉：Please …

examples.en: Open the window, please.
Don’t be late again.

exercises.question: ___ here.
找出错误：Don’t to run in the hall.
options: Don’t to run in the hall

title: 情态动词 must
explanation: must 表示“必须”，语义很强，否定 mustn’t 表示“禁止”。
rules: must + 动词原形
否定：must not / mustn’t
所有人称同形

examples.en: You must wear a seat belt.
You mustn’t talk loudly here.

exercises.question: We ___ finish the work today.
找出错误：You must to finish it now.
options: You must to finish it now

title: 连接词 and / but / so
explanation: 连词用来连接句子。and 表示并列，but 表示转折，so 表示结果。
rules: and：并列顺承
but：转折对比
so：因果关系

examples.en: I like tea and I like coffee too.
It was late, so I went home.
examples.zh: 天晚了，所以我就回家了。

exercises.question: I studied hard, ___ I passed the exam.
He is rich, ___ he is not happy.

title: 频率副词
explanation: 频率副词表示动作发生的频率，通常位于动词前、be 动词后。
rules: 程度排序：always > usually > often > sometimes > never
一般动词前：I often read
be 动词后：It is always cold

examples.en: I always brush my teeth before bed.
She never eats fast food.

exercises.question: 排序：usually / he / walks / to school
I ___ at six.
